videos.description: Learn how to offer AI real estate video creation as a professional service. Develop service packages, prepare client checklists, communicate with brokers, and establish responsible practices for delivering trustworthy property marketing content.
videos.notes:
SKILLOMATE  |  AI REAL ESTATE VIDEOS1
SKILLOMATE / COURSE NOTES
Lesson 08 - Turning the Workflow into a Service
Learning outcome: Package property-video production into a responsible service for brokers and
builders.
Build three packages
Create Basic, Standard and Premium tiers by varying the number of staged photos, lighting upgrades,
walkthrough clips, montage elements and final reels. Include "Virtually Staged" disclosure in every tier. The
course does not prescribe prices; set them yourself based on your work and market.
Collect a proper client brief
Request original property photos from useful angles, actual listing details, verified features and a clear
permission statement authorizing AI staging with disclosure. Do not assume the broker has permission to alter
third-party photos.
Prepare a realistic broker pitch
A short friendly Hinglish WhatsApp message can explain that you can create furnished, evening and cinematic
reel variations from empty-flat photos and attach an actual sample reel. Do not promise buyers, views or sales.
Five honesty rules
Label every AI-staged visual; preserve real room dimensions and structural features; never invent a balcony or
window view; never depict nonexistent amenities; and verify location, floor, area and features before
publication.
Final deliverable
Prepare a three-tier package sheet, client checklist, permission line, sample broker message and five-rule
review sheet. Use the same disclosure standard in samples and paid work.

The Indore flat is a sample scenario, not a verified listing. Exact copy-paste prompt wording is maintained in the original All
Prompts document; use that document when verbatim reproduction is required.

courses.title: AI Se Landing Page Banao

This practical course covers everything from planning your website and writing content to generating images, creating website code, and publishing your page online. videos.description: Discover what landing pages are, how they help local businesses attract enquiries and receive orders, and how AI simplifies website creation. Get introduced to the essential tools and understand the complete process of building and selling landing pages without coding experience.
videos.notes:
SKILLOMATE  •  AI Se Landing Page Banao1
SKILLOMATE | DETAILED LESSON NOTES
Lesson 01 — Course Introduction
Learning objective
Define a landing page, its single conversion goal and the full no-code course journey.
Concepts and explanations
• A landing page is a focused page built around one action, here a WhatsApp enquiry or order.
• Local businesses may use it alongside social media to organize offers, examples and contact information.
• Sweet Crumbs is a sample home bakery in Indore.
Step-by-step lesson workflow

• Explain their likely page goal.
• List ChatGPT, Google Flow, VS Code, Chrome, Netlify, Maps and Sheets as the course tools.
How to check your work
Compare the result against the original business brief and confirm that no new product claims, pricing,
contact details, testimonials or guarantees were introduced.
For the Sweet Crumbs demonstration, verify the specific file names, page goal and section structure before
moving to the next lesson.
If an AI response is incomplete, request the missing portion and recheck the combined result instead of
assuming it is ready to publish.
Practical assignment
Write down three business categories and one realistic goal for each.
Common mistake and integrity rule

courses.title: Making an commerce platform with AI
courses.description:
Learn how to create a complete e-commerce store using AI, without Shopify or previous coding
experience. Through a practical candle-store example, you'll plan your brand, organize product
information, and create attractive product images and descriptions using ChatGPT and Google Flow. You'll
build a mobile-friendly storefront with product listings, individual product pages, a shopping cart and
checkout, while managing products, prices and stock through Google Sheets. Next, you'll connect
customer orders to a Google Apps Script-powered orders sheet and prepare WhatsApp order messages,
with UPI or cash-on-delivery arrangements handled directly with customers rather than through an
integrated payment gateway. You'll also create essential business information pages, publish your store
on Netlify, and learn how to test the full customer journey. Finally, explore honest ways to introduce your
store to customers and use your completed project as a portfolio example when offering store-building
services to local businesses. By the end, you'll understand the full workflow and have a repeatable
process you can adapt to your own products, brand and business policies.

videos.title: Course Introduction
videos.description:

journey, from browsing products and adding them to a cart to submitting a WhatsApp order. The lesson
introduces ChatGPT, Google Sheets, Google Apps Script, Google Flow, VS Code and Netlify, using the
sample candle business Mitti & Wax. You will also understand why payments are coordinated manually
through UPI or cash on delivery rather than through a built-in payment gateway. By the end of this lesson,
you'll know how to apply these steps to your own store while keeping the business details accurate.
